outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the n=141 individual samples is plotted as its own marker; histograms show distributions. Scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points, and the points shown already are the individual measurements.
Scatter plot with error bars representing mean ± s.d. per cell line/reporter. Scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement per the check's plot-type exemptions.
Line/density plot showing distributions per subtype. Line plots are exempt because overlaying individual points would make them unreadable.
Box plots of CWT ridge lengths, which are exempt by plot type, and additionally show individual data points (dots) overlaid on each box.

Polar histograms show averaged Bmal1-Per2 phase differences per cell line across multiple replicates, but no individual replicate data points are overlaid; only the averaged bar height per bin is shown. Histograms of averaged values are not in the exempt category (only unbinned raw histograms/box/violin/line/scatter/pie are exempt) and hide replicate-level variability.

Polar histogram of Bmal1-Per2 phase differences averaged and colored by subtype (aggregating 1-4 cell line models per subtype); no individual cell-line or replicate data points are shown, only the averaged bars.

This panel shows a single example signal trace with a fitted decaying sinusoidal model for illustration, not an averaged summary statistic across a sample population, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Scatter plot of individual samples (n=117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty per sample; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points overlay requirement.
